ranges.purpose: 12f5:0a51 sound-enabled guard, request1 and caller cleanup

evidence: Statically inferred title request lifecycle plus independent controller/browser acceptance. No new original runtime capture, original complete intro timing or hardware waveform comparison.

environment.initialSound: Muted by default. First sound-enable gesture while the title is displayed supplies the initial enabled sound option late; it starts request1 once. Subsequent mute/unmute does not replay it. Explicit browser Restart initializes a fresh title.
environment.audio: Persistent Tandy original driver4 sequencer on the real audio sample clock; PC speaker uses existing rendition. Sound completion does not advance the title.
environment.presentation: Existing static MAIN.ARC2 title retained. Original crop/reveal/story/security sequence is incomplete and not validated by this milestone.

scenario.inputs: Authored controller events in tests/title-audio.test.js; actual sound controls and keyboard in tests/browser/title-audio.spec.js.
scenario.checks: Exact request order/once-only lifecycle, natural native browser completion, no automatic loop, restart and Fire reset, original source hashes.
scenario.negativeControl: Removing the title start must fail the controller request checker.
scenario.artifacts: Local browser screenshot .local/browser-results/title-audio.png. No proprietary data committed.

receipts.scope: Run-specific port acceptance outputs; not original runtime fixtures, expected checkpoints or replay inputs. A rerun produces a new log.
